description.p: Book Shelf is a personal library manager: add books by ISBN with automatic metadata from Open Library, track lending with borrowers and a trust score, follow your reading with status, dates and goals, and review your collection with statistics and pie charts.
It can import and export Excel spreadsheets, contribute missing books back to Open Library, and speaks six languages.
New application icons and logo, desktop and AppStream metadata, and official RPM, DEB and Arch packages.
